## What this region is

The comment rule agents obey (source keeps only daggers, machine directives and the rare one-line why:everything else goes to the gloss) and the source-side machinery that enforces it: comment classification, the repo's config, the dagger-to-declaration resolver and.

## What it exists for

- Run a gloss command over the repo to find or repair problems
- Decide where a piece of commentary goes
- Tune the comment rule per repo in package.json
- Decide when to read and how much to trust a margin note
- Work out which comments in a file are directives and which are harvestable
- Apply the package.json gloss config before scanning
- Lint source for comment-rule violations from code

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- move these comments out of the file into the margin and add the daggers → sidecar-harvest-and-check
- the check says a section has no dagger after I renamed the function → sidecar-harvest-and-check
- how old is this margin note compared with the code → read-and-staleness
- install the comment rule into our CLAUDE.md → agent-integration-setup-and-cli
- check whether agents actually follow the comment rule after I edit the snippet → behavioural-evals
